summary: The test suite covers the core requirements well — retention policies (max age, keep-latest-N, max total size), dry-run mode, deletion plans, error handling — and includes both unit and workflow structure tests. However, it lacks important boundary-condition tests (e.g., exactly at threshold, empty artifact lists, zero-size artifacts) and does not test the --output JSON parameter or certain policy interaction scenarios. The tests are well-organized with good use of fixtures and pytest patterns, but would miss subtle bugs at edge cases and in complex multi-policy scenarios. Fixture files referenced by the test harness (fixtures/*.json, cleanup-config.env) are not shown, making it harder to verify the pipeline tests will actually work as intended.
